ui_bugs.issue: Backdrop click does not close the catalogue preview in the normal card-hover/click state. The lightbox overlay is not full-screen: measured bounding box was x=868.328,y=570.594,width=344.328,height=1034.297 on a 1920x1080 viewport, so clicking the page backdrop at (20,20) is outside the overlay and leaves it open. This violates the required 'backdrop click all work' behavior and is not the exact same fullscreen swatch lightbox pattern.

issues: The preview modal appears constrained to the material card/column when opened from a hovered/focused card, rather than covering the full viewport.

action_items: Move catalogue-preview-lightbox out of the transformed MaterialCard subtree (e.g. portal to document.body or parent-level lightbox state) so it covers the viewport and backdrop click closes reliably, matching ShortlistSection's lightbox behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: MatchPreviewButton renders a position:fixed modal inside MaterialCard. MaterialCard applies scale/translate transforms on hover/focus, which creates a containing block for fixed descendants and breaks fullscreen/backdrop behavior.

rca_of_the_issue: The new inline MatchPreviewButton lightbox is rendered inside MaterialCard. When the user clicks from a hovered card, MaterialCard is focused and has transform classes (scale-[1.025] and -translate-y-1). CSS transforms establish a containing block for fixed-position descendants, so the supposed fixed inset-0 overlay is fixed relative to the card instead of the viewport. The visible modal can be closed with X/ESC, but clicking the page backdrop outside the card does not hit the overlay.
